We've been trying to accept the supplier portal invite you sent for Metalpine (PO 4501) but the "Accept" link in the email resolves to a 404 when the message is forwarded internally at our company. I attached a screenshot of the error and the forwarded header from the internal mail thread.

What I see: when my colleague forwards your invite to our procurement alias, the link appears to break (the URL gets a line break and the webserver returns 404). After we finally clicked through (copy/paste) we still don't see the PO in our Coupa "Invoices/Orders" area — the PO is in your system but not visible to our account.

Can you please:
- re-issue the invite as a raw URL (not inline HTML) and include the invite token in the body,
- confirm whether the invite is scoped to a specific email alias (we sometimes forward to procurement@metalpine.com), and
- provide an audit/log that shows the invite acceptance and the PO 4501 visibility state from your side?

Attachments: screenshot-accept-link.png (PNG), forwarded-headers.txt (plain text)

Thanks — we have a PO cut and need the vendor onboarding completed before next Tuesday.

Kimberly / Marissa — I dug into this with Platform Ops (ticket INC-2026-1873). TL;DR: the invite redirect chain is tolerant but Metalpine's gateway rewrites long HTML links and inserts CRLFs causing the token portion to be split at ~78 chars. When our link contains a hyphen near the wrap point the downstream parser drops the trailing token segment.

We have two mitigation options:
- Short-term: resend an invite using a short redirect URL (short code) so it's < 64 chars and will not wrap. I've generated one and attached PO_4501.pdf to the internal ticket so procurement can proceed.
- Mid-term: engineering will deploy a landing page that accepts a token either in the querystring OR as a one-time code entered on the page (so users can paste the code if the URL wraps). ETA for landing page: 2 sprints (approx. 3 weeks).

If procurement is blocked this week, Kimberly, mark the vendor as claimed and push the PO through manually. Linda — you should get a short-link invite in a separate email from ops@redwood-inference.com in ~10 minutes. Please confirm when you receive it and whether you can accept from the forwarded alias.

Ben
Director, Field Reliability
Redwood Inference
